title: Wendell and the Inheritance
author: Dominic Okonkwo
blurb: Ansel Underhill, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
